screen.note: Full HD 1920x1080 native resolution calibrated to Demo SS screenshots. Calibrate with calibrate_coordinates.py if your window layout differs.

step1_chat.name: Step 1: Open & Focus Chat Area
step1_chat.name_hi: स्टेप 1: चैट एरिया / (?) बैज पर क्लिक व फोकस करना
step1_chat.description: Hover over chat conversation row with (?) Action required badge and click to bring focus

step2_recommended.name: Step 2: Select (Recommended) Option
step2_recommended.description: Hover over the recommended option card in the right-side chat work area (X=1050, Y=664, well clear of left project explorer) and click to select

step3_submit.name: Step 3: Click Submit / Confirm Button
step3_submit.name_hi: स्टेप 3: सबमिट / कन्फर्म बटन पर क्लिक करना
step3_submit.description: Hover over the active bright-blue Submit button at bottom right and click to confirm

step4_verify.name: Step 4: Verify Execution & Settle State
step4_verify.name_hi: स्टेप 4: एक्शन निष्पादन और स्टेट वेरिफिकेशन
step4_verify.description: Verify submission by checking mouse state and saving debug screenshot
